issues.detail: The Greek 'ποιος' (implied by the structure/context of 'τι' in some manuscripts or the specific phrasing) or more accurately the 'τι' (what/that) combined with the interrogative sense in this specific context is often rendered as a question. However, the Vietnamese uses 'Sao' (Why), which changes the nature of the inquiry from 'What [do they say]?' to 'Why [do they say]?'
